mechanism_narrative: A current federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A current unemployment rate above 8.0% signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE is above 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 220) and high policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) signal a tightening monetary cycle that increases equity discount rates and reduces earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 220 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-demand regime characterized by strong housing starts (HOUST > 500) and robust consumer spending (RSAFS > 300000), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns due to elevated corporate earnings growth and investor confidence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST > 500 and RSAFS > 300000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90 signals weakening economic activity, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 90.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) supports equity valuations over the medium term, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate above 550 (thousands of units) signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 550.

mechanism_narrative: A payroll employment level below 130000 (thousands) signals a contracting labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS < 130000.
